stem: Which diagram shows a cause-and-effect relationship related to the Spanish-American War?

options.label: F
options.text: United States acquires new territories in the Caribbean and Pacific → Growth of U.S. commerce and influence

options.label: G
options.text: The opening of a transcontinental railroad → Expansion of U.S. trade and shipping

options.label: H
options.text: The development of conservationist policies → National parks established in the United States

options.label: J
options.text: Allied forces fight against the Central powers in Europe → U.S. businesses produce military supplies

visual_elements: Four cause-and-effect diagrams labeled F, G, H, J with text in boxes connected by arrows
